goal: Collect anonymous feedback from students to improve teaching
scenario: As an instructor, I want to use a simple tool where students can submit feedback without logging in, so that I get honest responses and can quickly view summary statistics.

goal: Quickly view summary statistics without navigating multiple pages
scenario: As an instructor, I want a single-page dashboard that shows average ratings per category and total feedback count, so I can immediately identify areas for improvement.

goal: Access raw feedback data for detailed review
scenario: As an instructor, I want to retrieve a list of all feedback entries via an API endpoint, so I can analyze individual comments and ratings.

goal: Submit honest feedback about courses quickly and easily
scenario: As a student, I want to fill out a short form without creating an account, so I can provide my feedback in one go and feel that my voice is heard.

goal: Ensure my feedback is recorded with correct course and instructor details
scenario: As a student, I want to enter the course name and instructor name accurately in the form, so my feedback is attributed correctly.

goal: Complete feedback in one go without account creation or extra steps
scenario: As a student, I want to submit feedback via a simple page without login or multi-step navigation, so I can finish quickly and anonymously.
